pages.text: One sample tells you about one spot. A $(thing)Soil Survey$() collects samples from across a plot and plans for the whole field.
$(thing)To file a result:$() when the lab has finished, right-click it holding the survey instead of collecting the report. Or hold the survey with a Soil Test Report in your other hand and use it.
A survey belongs to the plot of its first sample; retesting a spot replaces the old result.

$(thing)Use the survey$() to read it:$(li)$(thing)Plot averages$() and the range across samples.$(li)$(thing)Plot plan:$() lime and fertiliser per block, and totals for the plot's area in doses and spreader loads.

$(li)$(thing)Spots & advice:$() samples that differ from the rest and need their own treatment, how many more samples a plot that size needs (about one per 1,000 blocks), and rotation advice from the crop history.$(li)A page for every sample.
